description: 서울특별시_지하철 실시간 도착정보(일괄) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울특별시. 실시간으로 지하철 도착정보를 서울시 전체역에 대해 제공하는 API입니다. 지하철호선ID, 지하철역ID, 지하철역명, 환승노선수, 열차종류 등의 정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: 서울특별시. The portal files it under the publisher 서울특별시. Its tags are 지하철, 실시간, 도착정보, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2023-12-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
